objective_zh: 在完全不訓練、不修改模型權重的情況下，量測並提升 MiniCPM5-1B 使用 skill、檢索證據與執行回饋的能力，評估在明確任務及成本範圍內能否接近 Qwen3.5-9B。

constraints.weights: Pinned original BF16; no SFT, LoRA, RL, distillation, gradient updates, learned memory, or tokenizer changes.
constraints.student_generation: Every student generation, repair, evidence selection and review uses MiniCPM5-1B. No larger-model fallback or hidden judge.
constraints.external_components: Deterministic Unicode lexical retrieval, typed state, calculator and isolated Python executor. Any later embedding/reranker is a separately declared ablation and its cost is counted.
constraints.old_results: The previous 518-question study and its frozen runtime remain unchanged. All previously exposed study questions are excluded from new final evaluation where applicable.
constraints.authority: Skills are optional procedures. Retrieved documents are evidence, never instructions that override the user or application contract.
constraints.claims: Measured task/system capability only; no conversion to a universal parameter-equivalent size, no global-optimality claim.

hypotheses.claim: Short applicable skill cards improve task accuracy over the same input, model and decoding without cards.
hypotheses.test: skill-only versus bare, then remove cards from the complete system

hypotheses.claim: Retrieving sufficient relevant evidence improves reading/knowledge answers; padding alone does not.
hypotheses.test: bare, sufficient-source diagnostic, actual retrieval, irrelevant retrieval, same-evidence padding

hypotheses.claim: Execution feedback improves mathematical/programming success beyond additional unsupported self-revision.
hypotheses.test: execution plus bounded repair versus no feedback and same-call self-revision

hypotheses.claim: External state preserves necessary evidence and constraints across bounded short calls.
hypotheses.test: state handoff versus full history at matched total output and call ceilings

hypotheses.claim: Additional inference budget helps only while new evidence, actions or distinguishable candidates are produced.
hypotheses.test: one/two/three calls, input budgets and adaptive versus fixed retry policy

evaluation.retention_domain: Fresh subject-stratified TMMLU+; report separately so adding easier grounded tasks cannot hide broad knowledge weakness.
evaluation.split_unit: Source document/article for QA, source problem plus detectable near duplicates for math/code/MC, semantic tool family for tools. One QA question per selected document group.
evaluation.primary_metric: Equal-weight mean of the four primary-domain question accuracies; all domain scores mandatory. TMMLU retention is a separate gate.
evaluation.code_protocol: One public example/test is available to every arm. Remaining tests are evaluation-only and never enter generation, retrieval or repair. Passing public tests is not final success.
evaluation.qa_protocol: Source passages without QA labels form the retrieval corpus. Sufficient-source oracle is diagnostic only. Quote membership proves provenance, not semantic entailment.
evaluation.math_protocol: Execution validates computation, not the translation from prose to equations. Incorrect mathematical models remain incorrect even if execution succeeds.
evaluation.tool_protocol: Report exact name/typed-argument accuracy separately from schema validity. No gold-driven repair, polarity guessing or identifier translation.
evaluation.statistics: Three fixed generation seeds for nominated final arms; average within question, paired stratified bootstrap across questions; document/family/subject cluster sensitivity. No claim of independent evidence from repeated seeds.
evaluation.public_overlap: Public benchmark pretraining contamination cannot be ruled out. New-to-this-campaign is not equivalent to unseen during pretraining.
evaluation.test_seal: Before test generation freeze source/skill/runtime hashes, chosen policies, model revisions, decoding, seeds, comparison list and stopping rules. No changes selected using final test outputs.

comparisons: MiniCPM bare versus MiniCPM skill only
MiniCPM bare versus MiniCPM retrieval only
MiniCPM retrieval versus retrieval plus skill
MiniCPM retrieval plus skill versus execution and repair
Complete MiniCPM versus same-call self-revision and component ablations
Complete MiniCPM versus Qwen bare with the same available task information
MiniCPM versus Qwen with the same retrieval, tools, state and budget ceilings

search.heuristic_notice: All margins, candidate counts and budgets below are preregistered engineering choices, not published optimal values.
search.input_controls: For long-context QA report real tokenizer lengths; fixed evidence with irrelevant padding and source positions at beginning/middle/end. Never silently drop mandatory task/schema/public-test content.
search.promotion: At least +1 primary macro percentage point on validation, no primary domain regression exceeding 3 pp and no TMMLU regression exceeding 3 pp. Report paired CIs even when inconclusive; tied/non-promoted policies remain visible.
search.stopping: Stop after the declared 18-policy search budget or three meaningfully different rounds without a promoted validation improvement. State budget-limited or local stopping as appropriate; do not assert no possible further progress.
search.cost: Record every model call including failed/retried calls, actual prompt/completion tokens, retrieval/execution latency and wall time. Serving throughput and end-to-end latency are distinct. Token counts across tokenizers are not FLOPs.

success_levels.criterion: Reproducible corpus/skills/runtime, Chinese retrieval, provenance-bound state, actual execution receipts, exclusion and leakage checks, complete test logs.
Final paired 95% CI for complete MiniCPM minus its bare control is above zero on primary macro, with domain and retention regressions disclosed.

For the named comparison and cost setting, upper endpoint of paired 95% CI for Qwen minus MiniCPM is at most 3 macro pp; no primary domain point-estimate gap exceeds 5 pp. Report TMMLU separately; failure there prevents any broad general-capability parity claim.

deliverables: Versioned reusable skill JSON/Markdown plus compact inference cards and applicability examples
Dependency-light retrieval/state/verification harness with explicit public-input boundary
Pinned data preparation, inference, scoring, bootstrap, ablation and sealing scripts
HTML goal/progress/result report, machine-readable metrics and raw local trajectories
Reviewable git branch and PR or patch; upstream merge remains a maintainer action
